title: sambucus miquelii
intro: Sambucus miquelii, commonly known as the Japanese elder, is a flowering plant species native to East Asia. It is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to alleviate various health conditions. The health benefits of Sambucus miquelii include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help to reduce fever and alleviate cold and flu symptoms. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as antiviral and antioxidant effects.
